folliculitis: Follicular papules with central keratin plug
lichenoid keratosis: Vascular loops with central red dots
paronychia: Linear vascular pattern in nail fold
Nail plate separation at lateral edge
Chronic thickening of proximal nail fold
Acute onset of nail fold redness
port wine stain: Dilated dermal vessels, no pigment network
xeroderma pigmentosum: Reticular pigment network, loss of structure
